messages:
tara: Short notice: we need a temporary runtime pin for long-seq model group (llama3-longseq) while we roll a kernel hotpatch. Target window tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC. Asking eng-runtime + ops to coordinate.
cheng: Why pin instead of patching runtime in-place? any compatibility risk?
tara: Kernel change touches attention kernel selector; safe when opt-in but can cause memory growth on some quant paths. Pin avoids exposing canary traffic to that variant until we validate.
deploybot: Action: create pin entry for runtime v4.8.0 -> cohort: canary-east, canary-eu. Use `deploybot pin temp <runtime> v4.8.0 --reason "longseq-kernel-hotpatch" --until 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z`.
ben: If we pin, how will routing choose fallback? will models get served by older runtime or a shim?
runtime-sam: Fallback routing: pinned runtime will route longseq models to runtime v4.7.5 (previous stable). No shim. We already tested v4.7.5 with those model flavours.
ops-elena: Ops note: Dedicated customers could be affected if they use longseq models in eu region. I'll queue a CS advisory and a jira for tracking.
docs-maya: I'll update release notes /runtime/ with a short entry: "Temporary runtime pin for long-seq model cohort due to kernel hotpatch validation." Anything else to include?
tara: Add rollback criteria: abort and unpin if any of the following during validation window: (1) >1% increase in user-facing error rate vs baseline over 5m; (2) memory RSS growth leading to OOM in any node; (3) token-decode mismatches > 0.1% on replayed eval.
cheng: QA plan: smoke replay of longseq prompts + end-to-end streaming checks. I'll run at 00:20 UTC. Command: `./bin/ci-replay --suite longseq-smoke --runtime v4.7.5 --target canary-eu --tag runtime-pin-test`
deploybot: Note: to opt-out of this temp pin, teams can `deploybot pin-sticky runtime v4.7.5` before 23:00 UTC. Sticky pins will survive the auto-unpin.
ben: If QA finds a mismatch, what's fast rollback?
tara: Fast rollback: abort pin job -> `deploybot unpin <job-id>` -> route longseq back to runtime v4.7.5 explicitly (deploybot route set). Then run minimal canary with patched kernel in isolated cluster.
runtime-sam: Confirmed: no kernel changes will be force-enabled on canary clusters unless we flip the opt-in flag; we'll hold that flag until post-validation.
ops-elena: Created CS advisory draft and escalation contacts. Posting now.
docs-maya: Added release note and a short FAQ for CS: "Why pinned? what to expect?" Live at /internal/docs/releases/5654321000-runtime-pin.md
cheng: Running replay now, will paste summary in 10m.
ben: I'll stand by for rollback if memory graphs spike.
cheng: Replay summary: 5000 prompts, 0.08% decode mismatches, latencies same, memory stable. QA green.
tara: Great. Proceeding with deploybot pin at 01:00 UTC. If anyone requests sticky-pin, please do before 23:00.
deploybot: Execution log: pin job started -> id pj-5654321000. Live: https://internal-logs/deploy/pj-5654321000
ops-elena: CS advisory sent to affected accounts.
ben: Observability check: no OOMs, error rate normal, slight knob in kv-cache hit-rate but within tolerance.
tara: Locking this thread. Will reopen if rollback needed. Thanks all!
